_comment: Add your own HTTP endpoints WITHOUT touching LiveCode. Drop this file (named .qsroutes.json) in the folder you share; No Cloud Quick Share reads it and serves the routes below. A route returns a canned body (optionally with {{...}} request values, always escaped), a file from this folder, or a redirect - no code runs. Paths under /_qs/ and /_edit/ are reserved, header values are sanitised, and this dotfile itself is never served. Requires the engine's JSON support (fails closed if absent). See docs/user-routes.md.
